title: The Dreamland band and how Oliver took over from Mutt Carey
summary: Hall describes the Dreamland band with Sugar Johnny, Lil Hardin, Mutt Carey and Dodds, and how Oliver took the band while Carey was away in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah, I wasn't quite old enough yet for the first draft. So when he went, I'd taken over, and in the meantime, I don't know what happened to Tuley Garland, but when I wound up, Breaux was playing bass, Wilmer Breaux. So that wound up with Wilmer Breaux, Sugar Johnny, Lawrence Dewey, Roy Palmer, myself and Lil Hardin. See, she was then Hardin, it wasn't Armstrong's right there. There's a picture, I've seen that picture of that band. Yeah, that's right. So we made it so good up there, at the meantime, Sugar Johnny they called him, the trumpet player. Smith was his name. Smith, yeah. He's taken sick. He went into T.B. So he just blowed till he couldn't blow no more. So I can't tell just how the band got left the job, but anyhow, we went to work at the Dreamland for Bill Bottoms. So while we were working there, Oliver came to town with a show called Mary Mack.
Yeah. So when Sugar Johnny died.
I guess that was his girlfriend for a while.

Yeah. So after Sugar died, I think if I'm not mistaken, I don't know who was playing trumpet. Well anyhow, no that's right, they got in Mud Carey, that's right. Mud Carey came in there once. That's right. Mud Carey came in there. And Johnny Dodds came up there together. Yeah. I don't know how the mix up come up, but it was at the Dreamland, then the band changed a little. Papa Mud was playing trumpet and Dodds was playing clarinet then. So at the meantime, Papa Mud wanted to take a trip back to New Orleans. So Oliver came to town with a show and Mud talked with Oliver about working, could he come back and work two weeks in his place. So they arranged the thing and at the meantime, while Mud was gone, Oliver took the band over. That's how he got the band. So then after Oliver took the band over, we worked the Dreamland for a pretty good while, and then we had two jobs. See we used to go to work, at that time night club, she called it one o'clock. Then we went to work down to Pekin after hours. And Tony Jackson was playing intermission piano. At the Pekin, I think.
